daily.title: Police did not pass on key information to prison before suicide, inquest hears
daily.summary: The inquest into a detainee who died by suicide hears police did not pass on critical information to prison staff which would have likely placed him on an at-risk mental health system.

daily.title: 'Like a torture chamber': Patients speak out about the horrors of ICU delirium
daily.summary: Doctors are investigating ICU delirium as they try to end the days of patients struggling with hallucinations and mental health issues during their recovery.

daily.title: Gas reservation scheme set to pass parliament in bid to rein in energy costs
daily.summary: Labor's plan to deliberately oversupply the domestic gas market is set to pass parliament, with the Coalition saying it will not oppose the bill.

daily.title: Gosling case link denied, as NT Administrator racks up travel bill
daily.summary: The NT chief minister claims "no involvement whatsoever" in the case against Labor MP Luke Gosling, as the NT Administrator racks up a $10k a day bill in the UK.

daily.title: Returning Matildas star Cooney-Cross wants to make late mum 'proud'
daily.summary: Kyra Cooney-Cross is preparing for her first Matildas' appearances since her mother's death in July, and she's ready to be back in the spotlight.

daily.title: Curtains have closed on parliament for the year. Who walks away a winner?
daily.summary: The government cleared almost everything it wanted off the legislative decks this week, but there were still plenty of surprises and shocks in store.

daily.title: Scale of voyeur doctor's offending 'beggars belief', Melbourne court told
daily.summary: Disgraced trainee surgeon Ryan Cho, who secretly filmed hundreds of colleagues in hospital toilets, could receive a reduced jail term because prosecutors combined his charges to streamline the case.

daily.title: Dramatic audio released of teen's arrest after electric motorbike death
daily.summary: A teenager accused of killing a Perth nurse after hitting her with an electric motorbike he was riding is heard telling police he only increased his speed because he was being chased by police.

daily.title: Boy who died sleeping in bin subject of 29 child abuse reports, court hears
daily.summary: A coronial inquest hears that dozens of abuse notifications were made involving the 13-year-old in the years leading up to his death after sleeping rough in a skip bin.

daily.title: Lamarre-Condon staying in secretive prison unit as police review resumes
daily.summary: Beau Lamarre-Condon's murder trial may be over but he now faces a long prison sentence and renewed scrutiny of his actions as a NSW Police officer.

daily.title: Coalition plan to partly privatise Melbourne's sewerage system if elected
daily.summary: Opposition Leader Jess Wilson will partly privatise Melbourne's sewerage network, cut and delay level crossing removals, and cancel expanding free kindergarten if elected on Saturday.

daily.title: Why the US Army detonated tonnes of toxic chemical near farmland
daily.summary: The US Army destroyed America's entire stockpile of a toxic bomb-making material in a controlled explosion in Iowa on Wednesday. Here's why.

daily.title: Canberra motorcyclist dies after colliding with pole
daily.summary: A 40-year-old man has died after his motorcycle left the road and hit a pole in Canberra's south this afternoon.

daily.title: Cane toad reported in Adelaide as authorities appeal for public lookout
daily.summary: South Australia's Department of Primary Industries and Regions has issued a public alert after receiving a report about a cane sighting in Adelaide's west.

daily.title: Prisoners have clothing, bedding and food withheld in 'degrading' regime
daily.summary: An unsanctioned punishment regime was operating for years at Tasmania's Risdon Prison, in which inmates were deprived of clothing, bedding, food and toilet paper for days at a time in response to behavioural issues.

daily.title: Victoria faces increased bushfire risk in 'mixed bag' of summer emergencies
daily.summary: Victoria's emergency management commissioner is warning of an increased risk of bushfires and grassfires this summer that could continue through to early autumn.

daily.title: Tasmania Police name alleged shooter of Sergeant Michael Preshaw
daily.summary: Tasmania Police name the man they believe shot Sergeant Michael Preshaw on Saturday night on Flinders Island as Jordan Jeffrey Willis.

daily.title: Anti-Netanyahu bloc vows to swear in Israel's new government by end of week

daily.title: Witness recounts dramatic 'crash tackle' arrest of balaclava-clad men
daily.summary: Tanya Hamilton witnessed the arrests in Lidcombe on Wednesday and her CCTV showed the incident unfold.

daily.title: ASIC sues major insurer over complaints handling and claims delays
daily.summary: The corporate regulator alleges the company mishandled more than 500 cases and automated the use of the word "complexity" in files to explain delays.

daily.title: Child protection inquiry announced after sustained pressure on government
daily.summary: The inquiry follows evidence of failings in the child protection system, as months of intense focus on the issue continues, especially in WA's Pilbara.

daily.summary: Mothers of leavers — or meavers — are an increasingly common sight at WA's traditional Leavers hot spots, as they too celebrate the end of their children's school years.

daily.title: Teacher who had sex with student after principal's warning avoids jail
daily.summary: Former teacher Zoe Jade Hodges has been spared jail time for having sex with a 17-year-old schoolboy who was in her care, with the judge finding the humiliation and loss of career were extra punishments.

daily.title: Court hears victim of alleged schoolies bashing has no sign of brain activity
